description: Energy consumption and renewable generation data of 5 aggregators - 15 minute resolution (13 bus grid) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jose Almeida, Bruno Canizes (GECAD, Polytechnic of Porto). Type: Energy consumption and renewable generation data Period of data collection: 19-03-2019 to 25-03-2019 (15-minute 672 periods) Resolution: 15 minutes Network: 13-bus MV grid Aggregator list: Aggregator 1: Shopping Mall; Hospital; Fire Station Aggregator 2: 15 houses Aggregator 3: 7 Office buildings Aggregator 4: Wind, PV Aggregator 5: Slow and fast-charging stations of electric vehicles ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
